test_install: test installing llama.cpp to an Android device via adb push and chmod
test_llama_cli_cpu: test running llama-cli on CPU device with q8_0 context tokens and value kernels
test_llama_cli_gpu: test running llama-cli on GPU via OpenCL with flash attention enabled
test_llama_cli_npu: test running llama-cli on NPU via HTP0 with q8_0 context tokens and value kernels
test_llama_bench_cpu: test benchmarking llama.cpp inference on CPU device with batch size 128
test_llama_bench_gpu: test benchmarking llama.cpp inference on GPU via OpenCL with batch size 128
test_llama_bench_npu: test benchmarking llama.cpp inference on NPU via HTP0 with batch size 128
run_llama_cli: run llama-cli on a specified device with custom options for text generation
run_llama_bench: run llama-bench on a specified device to measure inference performance
run_cmd: run an adb shell command and assert it returns exit code zero
